## 🎉 What's New in v0.14.3

This release brings your fork fully in sync with the upstream project — headlined by a long-awaited fix that makes **heat/cool (auto) mode hit exactly the temperatures you set**, plus the ability to run your fan together with the heater, and six new languages.

---

## ✨ New Features

### 🌀 Run the fan together with your heater
**Your fan can now circulate air whenever the heater or heat pump is running.**

- Enable the new `fan_on_with_heater` option and the fan turns on and off in lockstep with heating.
- Great for distributing heat from a single source (fireplace insert, heat pump head unit) through the room.
- Fully optional — nothing changes unless you turn it on.

- Details: #622, #623 (upstream)

### 🌍 Six new languages
**The configuration UI now speaks Hungarian, Norwegian, Portuguese, Brazilian Portuguese, Swedish, and Ukrainian — and the Slovak translation is now complete.**

- Details: #621 (upstream)

---

## 🐛 Bug Fixes

### 🔧 Auto (heat/cool) mode hits the right temperatures
Tolerances are now directional and per-loop, so heating and cooling each start and stop where you'd expect. In heat/cool mode the cooler now kicks in at `target_high + hot_tolerance` and the heater at `target_low − cold_tolerance`, with `heat_tolerance`/`cool_tolerance` acting as each device's own hysteresis.

**Example:** Set your range to 20–24 °C with a 0.5° tolerance and the cooler now engages at **24.0 °C** instead of overshooting to 24.5 °C.

Configs that don't set heat/cool tolerances behave exactly as before.

- Details: #612, #613, #620 (upstream)

### 🔧 Preset placeholder guard hardened
The "treat preset temperatures of 0 as unset" protection from v0.14.0 now uses the upstream project's canonical implementation, applied consistently everywhere a preset temperature is read — including templates that momentarily render 0 when a source sensor is unavailable. Genuine low presets like anti-freeze (5 °C) keep working, and a batch of new template tests locks the behavior in.

- Details: #598 (upstream)

---

## 📊 By the Numbers

- **2 new features** — fan with heater, 6 new languages
- **2 bug fixes** — heat/cool tolerances, preset placeholder guard
- **1658 tests** — all passing
- **100% backward compatible** — no configuration changes needed

---

## 🔄 Migration Guide

**Drop-in replacement.** No configuration changes required. All new capabilities are opt-in.
